resource_terms.resource_aggregation: Maximum, not sum. Means retain every repetition; independent component repetitions are not paired by index.

scope: worker-r1 instrumented synchronized device envelope, not uninstrumented request-only serving performance
arithmetic_convention: Pre-existing valid-row add/subtract/multiply convention; GEMM uses 2MNK. Global TP operations count once; GDN TP shards are summed once. This is source-semantic work, not physical instruction counting.
exclusions: State-update-eligible preprocessing is an alternative scope, not an additional family.
Prefix scan is already in the GDN prefill H/O ledger.
Q/K L2 preprocessing is excluded from the RMS ledger.
Special functions, division, comparison and unary negation retain separate counts without arbitrary FLOP weights.
Tail operations and replicated TP hidden normalization are not added to this request-window semantic subtotal.
reference_scope_review: GMM is timed without SwiGLU. SwiGLU is a separate component.
Shared sigmoid gate and shared/routed addition are in combine only; router-gate covers routing and the distinct full-attention gate.
GDN output gated RMSNorm is distinct from MoE SwiGLU and full-attention gating.
Q/K L2 is in preprocessing, excluded from RMS arithmetic; attention softmax is included in FIA, not an extra timed component.
H/O receives cumulative gates; its timed call excludes prefix scan. WY chunk_wy includes cumulative_gates, KKT, inverse and W/U reconstruction.
Dense projection references exclude vocabulary and routed expert grouped projections.
Memory-only movement and collectives are not invented floating-point arithmetic. HBM and communication terms remain separate resource bounds.
Full-attention Q/K RMS is fused into RoPE reference, absent from separate timed norm cases; its arithmetic remains counted once in the norm ledger.
Norm schedule uses prepare_norm_reference_r2: 70 full-row residual calls plus 10 partitioned FA residual calls per target forward, not the obsolete r1 schedule.
limitations: The device envelope includes 49.021044731 seconds before the first request and 2.441787004 seconds after the last response. These are not removed from envelope-wide resource accounting.
Trace instrumentation and client startup/control overhead are present. This result is not a new formal B1 throughput score or proof that the uninstrumented service has the same attainment.
Calibrations use synthetic inputs and hot replay; they are empirical workload-shaped references, not guaranteed hardware maxima or the exact model critical path.
HBM physical read/write mix differs from the logical target by about 3.6%; both pooled and direction-constrained terms are retained. Neither dominates this resource maximum.
Special functions, division, comparisons, unary negation, parameter transforms, graph padding and redundant TP arithmetic retain the frozen exclusions; no arbitrary FLOP weights are assigned.
Numerical qualification mixes full output/state checks and sampled CPU checks by operator; it does not replace dataset quality validation.
